text: Did you know that if you mash one boiled potato with avocado, add eggs, Greek yogurt,
baking powder, and salt, and mix the whole lot together until smooth. Then shape it into buns,
brush the tops with egg yolk, chuck sesame seeds over, and bake until golden. What you get are
incredibly soft fluffy avocado potato buns with zero flour anywhere near them. Click the link in
my bio to get my book full of healthy recipes, and don't forget to follow me for more.
